title: Create ComparisonView grouped findings component
description:
Create `dashboard/frontend/components/editor/ComparisonView.tsx`.

Props: `olderAudit` (SpeedAuditResult), `newerAudit` (SpeedAuditResult), `onExit` (callback).

Internal logic:
- Import `computeComparison` from `./audit-history-utils` (created in Task 2). Call it with the two audits to get `{ removed, unchanged, added }` arrays.
- Render three sections in order: Removed, Unchanged, Added.

Section rendering:
- Each section has a header using existing `fv-group-header` class pattern: `--font-mono`, 10px, weight 500, `--color-text-tertiary`. Text: "Removed", "Unchanged", or "Added".
- Section gap: `4px` between sections.
- If a section has zero items, render "(none)" in `--font-sans`, 12px, `--color-text-tertiary`, italic.
- Each section group gets `role="group"` with `aria-label`: "Removed findings", "Unchanged findings", "Added findings".

Finding row rendering:
- Removed rows: text in `--color-emerald` at 60% opacity with `text-decoration: line-through`. Background tint: `rgba(68, 204, 119, 0.08)`.
- Added rows: text in `--color-red` at 80% opacity. Background tint: `rgba(239, 68, 100, 0.08)`.
- Unchanged rows: standard finding text styling (`--color-text-secondary`, 13px, `--font-sans`).
- Row padding: `8px 12px`. Hover: `--color-bg-card-hover` background.
- Each row shows severity icon and truncated message (truncate at 65 chars with ellipsis).

Footer: "Exit comparison" link at bottom. `--font-sans`, 11px, `--color-text-tertiary`. Hover: `--color-text-secondary`. On click: call `onExit`.

The entire component is wrapped in a scrollable container. Content swap uses the existing `fvFadeIn` animation (150ms ease, opacity 0→1).
acceptance_criteria:
- [test] ComparisonView renders Removed, Unchanged, Added sections in that order
- [test] Empty section displays (none) text
- [test] Exit comparison link calls onExit callback on click
- [test] Each section group has role=group and appropriate aria-label
- [test] computeComparison is imported from audit-history-utils, not reimplemented
- [test] Finding messages truncated at 65 chars with ellipsis
- [manual] Removed rows have line-through text decoration and emerald tint background
- [manual] Added rows have red-tinted background at rgba(239, 68, 100, 0.08)

decisions: Defined fvFadeIn keyframe in the component's inline <style> block (opacity only, as spec says '0→1') rather than referencing the one in IntelPanel.tsx, so the component works standalone.
Used index as React key for issue rows since AuditIssue has no id field and arrays are stable/computed.
Extracted FindingRow and Section as internal components to avoid duplicating the 3-section render pattern.
Kept hover background as var(--color-bg-card-hover) applied via class, which overrides the section tint — this is intentional so hover state is always legible.
concerns: Test coverage deferred to Task 10 (ComparisonView.test.tsx) per task spec — this is expected.

If ComparisonView is rendered inside IntelPanel (which also defines @keyframes fvFadeIn with a translateY), there will be two keyframe declarations with the same name. The later one in DOM order wins. The IntelPanel version includes translateY; mine is opacity-only. If Task 9 nests this inside IntelPanel, the animation may pick up IntelPanel's definition instead.
